name: ai-design-skills
one_liner: A free, drop-in instruction file that teaches your AI coding tool how to design a professional-looking landing page instead of a generic one, with more skills promised later.
buyer: A solo SaaS founder or freelance developer who can code but can't design, and needs their AI-built landing page to look like it came from a real design studio.
business_use_cases: A solo SaaS founder installs the skill so their AI assistant builds a launch landing page with real conversion copy and a coherent visual system instead of a generic template.
A freelance developer uses it as a standard starting point on every client project to guarantee a baseline of design quality without hiring a designer.
An agency forks it, edits the design-values section to match a client's brand, and reuses that customized skill across that client's future pages.

money_ideas.idea: Sell forked, pre-branded versions of the skill (fonts/colors/motion locked to a specific brand) to agencies as a paid starter kit.
Offer paid custom skill-writing for other page types (pricing pages, dashboards) beyond the single landing-page skill currently included.

steal_this: It's free, MIT-licensed, and explicitly says 'use it, fork it, ship it, sell what you build with it' — the fastest move is literally installing it and shipping a client landing page with it this weekend, no separate product needed.
